== Title ==
<span lang="ja">リージェスク</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">毎ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、1度だけ、1フォース消費して敵のロスト・デッキか「墜落記念碑」をあさり、ビークル、ドロイド、武器、アイテムのいずれかを1枚、自分の手札にいれて、自分のカードとして使用できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">アラリア出身のラナットの盗賊にして廃品あさり。ジャワとの取引が多い。持ち主が気付かぬうちに品物を盗む。ガラクタだろうがなんだろうが、どんなものでも盗みたがる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Reegesk]].

'''Lore''' — A Ranat thief and scavenger from Aralia. He often trades with Jawas. He steals goods before the owner notices. He wants to steal anything, even junk.

'''Game text''' — Once each turn during your control phase, spend 1 Force to rummage the opponent's Lost Pile or Crash Site Memorial. Take one vehicle, droid, weapon, or device into hand and use it as your own.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese spends 1 Force; English loses 1 Force. Lost Pile is ロスト・デッキ. Crash Site Memorial is 「墜落記念碑」. Device is アイテム. 盗賊 is not bold.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-reegesk.gif|Original English face]], [[Reegesk]].</ref>
